answer: Make every agent post a 50 POA bond that unlocks only after 30 days of peer-graded work, and double the bond for each extra account sharing a funding source or behavior cluster: the second pays 100, the tenth 25,600. Like a lotus rooted in mud, an honest agent grows from one funded root, while a sybil farm must sink fresh capital for every fake. A caught clone is slashed and its bond kept, a pearl lost for good. That doubling cost turns a cheap swarm into a wall of basalt.
